title: Sorry not a fan
text: Sorry not a fan. Soft enough but too lumpy on my double bed.  This drives me crazy!  Doesn’t fit the bed tight.

product_metadata.title: Allrange Breathable Coolmax Quilted Mattress Pad, Coolmax and Cotton Fabric Cover, Snug Fit Stretchy to 18" Deep Pocket, Polyester Fill, Mattress Protector, Full
features: 【A BREATHABLE MATTRESS PAD】This sweat absorbing mattress pad is made of CoolMax fabric and 200-thread-count cotton. CoolMax fibers could accelerate sweat absorbing and evaporation so that night sweaters would feel more breathable and drier. Diamond quilting keeps you sleeping sound in any position without noise.Stretch-up-to 18” deep skirt gives your mattress a snug-fit. It is easy to take care by machine washing.PRODUCT DIMENSION ( L X W ):54"X75"+16"

【COTTON and COOLMAX FABRIC】Helps to balance your temperature change and regulate the heat built up, and the COOLMAX Cooling moisture wicking technology provides air-refreshing and breathable feeling and keeps you clean and comfortable while sleeping. NOTES: a warm or thick sheet (on top of mattress pad) would counteract its temperature regulating function, so we recommend to use this mattress pad with thin or cooling sheet. This is not a heated, heating or electronic mattress pad.

【DIAMOND QUILTING】Diamond stitch quilting pattern prevents the polyester filling from clumping and shifting, and enables the filling to be evenly spread below you cushioning your pressure points. SNUG FITTING: 16” weft-knitted skirt could stretch up to 18” deep, providing a snug fit to mattress with minimum fuss.
【HIGH STANDARD MANUFACTURING】With high standard manufacturing processes and high- quality materials honestly listed above.

【EASY CARE】It is machine washable and we recommend using FRONT LOAD commercial washer and dryer. Gentle or delicate setting, cold water, mild or all-natural detergent is preferred. Easy care and easy maintenance.
